🧭 Back to [Harvesters Overview](overview.qmd)

One of SVP Harvester's main tasks is to convert the various formats originating from the source platforms into a
common data model compatible with the Semantic Web standards.

## Reference model

The target model used to represent scientific output in SVP Harvester is inspired by the
[ABES Science Plus model](https://documentation.abes.fr/aidescienceplusabes/index.html#ModeleGeneral).

For more information about modeling choices and mapping with source formats, see the
[Modeling working group reports](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1352335371).

> 🔗 This is the same target model referenced by the per-harvester data conversion tables — see
> [HAL](hal.qmd#data-conversion), [IdRef](idref.qmd#data-conversion), [ScanR](scanr.qmd#data-conversion),
> [OpenAlex](openalex.qmd#data-conversion), [Scopus](scopus.qmd#data-conversion) — and by the reference event
> payloads published on the `publications` exchange, documented in the
> [Message Catalog](../map/message_catalog.qmd#exchange--publications).
